verdict.rationale: Phoenix's first-party docs describe Prompt Management for versioning, storing, and deploying prompts. Client SDKs keep prompts in sync across applications and environments, so a production app can pick up prompt changes from Phoenix instead of through a code release. The docs also cover testing prompt variants against datasets before rolling them out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of environment/label-based promotion (e.g., tagging a version as production) and runtime fetch semantics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-redeploy workflow.
